decision_points.requirement: The Welcome verifier removes only producer_proof, canonicalizes the complete remaining closed host object, and compares its independently recomputed SHA-256 digest before trusting the signature.
The exact context plus one LF prefixes the RFC 8785 JCS five-member envelope, and Ed25519 verifies over those reconstructed bytes.
The structured authority basis binds commit_event_ref to the winning Commit Event's exact producer actor, verified method and public key rather than a governance, recipient or claim-service key.

test_material_warning: Published conformance-only private seeds; MUST NOT be used in production.

owner_transfer.boundary: Real independent Ed25519 signatures and schema-bound finite intent. Current Account/Device/root authority, membership and lifecycle below are explicit qualified reference inputs, not native PCR, remote directory, storage or HTTP proof.

transport.boundary: Actual C-signature bytes and typed reference wrappers. did:web HTTPS retrieval/authority and both source document observations are qualified inputs, not native DID history or peer HTTP execution. Primary producer authority is checked separately by the original ingress.
transport.retention_boundary: archive_input_coordinates are pre-acceptance reference inputs. Native admission must atomically bind the actual resulting Event/RealmCommit and original W1 full wrapper/ref, and handoff its complete opaque management-state set; this KAT does not manufacture a successful native Commit, private archive or handoff.
